info: Plan G, based on Plan C. The study wall is carried all the way to the window, splitting the west side into a maid room (window end, about 1.7 × 2.9 m, single bed, wardrobe, aircon) and the study by the shelter (two standing desks, sliding door, as Plan C). The TV sits on the maid-room wall as a marble and fluted-walnut feature wall; the maid room door is hidden in the fluted panels next to the TV. The L-sofa sits against the bedroom 3 wall with its chaise towards the dining side. Kitchen: closed or open with bi-fold glass. A maid room without its own window opening onto the corridor must be checked with HDB / your ID. Power points and trunking are indicative.
